title: A Bellman Optimality Equation for Plasticity
abstract: arXiv:2609.10776v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In continual reinforcement learning, carefully managing the stability-plasticity tradeoff remains a core challenge. Recent work by Abel et al. (2025) formalized this dilemma by defining plasticity as the generalized directed information from an agent's observations to its actions, and empowerment as the generalized directed information from its actions to its observations. This formulation successfully reframes the traditional stability-plasticity tradeoff as an empowerment-plasticity tradeoff. However, while extensive literature exists on optimizing for empowerment, there is currently no research addressing the optimization of plasticity under this new definition. This paper presents preliminary work toward optimizing plasticity within Markov decision processes. We show that there exists a Bellman optimality equation for optimizing plasticity similar to previous work for empowerment.

translated_title: 可塑性的贝尔曼最优方程
translated_abstract: 在持续强化学习中，如何妥善管理稳定性-可塑性权衡始终是一个核心挑战。Abel等人（2025）最近的工作将这一困境形式化：将可塑性定义为从智能体的观测到其动作的广义定向信息，将赋权定义为从其动作到其观测的广义定向信息。这一表述成功地将传统的稳定性-可塑性权衡重构为赋权-可塑性权衡。然而，尽管关于优化赋权已有大量文献，但目前尚无研究探讨如何在该新定义下优化可塑性。本文展示了在马尔可夫决策过程中优化可塑性的初步工作。我们证明了存在一个类似于此前赋权研究工作中的、用于优化可塑性的贝尔曼最优方程。
tldr: 本文首次提出了用于优化可塑性的贝尔曼最优方程，为持续强化学习中赋权-可塑性权衡框架下的可塑性优化问题迈出了初步的一步。
en_tdlr: This paper presents preliminary work showing that a Bellman optimality equation exists for optimizing plasticity in Markov decision processes, analogous to prior work on empowerment optimization.
